text:
mirelle: starting perf validation for sea1 gpu cluster (sea1-gpu-pool-01). focus: kernel/driver sanity, NIC offloads/MTU, inter-node throughput, p95 decode latency, and NCCL all-reduce smoke. attaching quick plan and asking for volunteers to run probes.

kevin: I can run the network stuff and basic nvidia checks. do we have node list + AMI?

mirelle: node list in infra-inventory (private link). AMI tag gpu-ami-2026-03-12. target instance type: p4d-like equivalence (8xA100) for soak; but first smoke on smaller nodes (4xA100 sim) to baseline.

kevin: starting with kernel/driver checks. run on one node:
```bash
ssh ubuntu@10.2.1.45
uname -a
cat /etc/os-release
sudo modinfo nvidia | head -n 20
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version,name,mig.mode.current --format=csv
```
I got: `Linux sea1-node-07 5.15.0-103-generic` and `NVIDIA-SMI 535.113.01    Driver Version: 535.113.01    CUDA Version: 12.1`

mirelle: good — driver >= 535 OK, CUDA 12.1 expected. also confirm grub kernel cmdline doesn't have mitigations that blow perf (spec_store_bypass=on?).

tj: I ran the NIC checks. MTU 9000 on the perf VLAN, and ethtool shows: `GSO: on GRO: on LRO: off`, rx/tx offloads enabled. Doing iperf3 10s between node-07 and node-08 (same rack):
```bash
iperf3 -c 10.2.1.46 -P 4 -t 10
[  5]  0.00-10.00  sec   14.6 GBytes  12.5 Gbits/sec  (sender)
```
latency (ping -M do -s 1500) p50 ~ 74us, p95 ~ 210us — that's within our rack baseline.

infra-ci-bot: smoke tests queued: nccl-allreduce-smoke, decode-latency-smoke, kernel-mod-check. Results will post here.

mirelle: for decode latency, use our micro-bench harness with these params: `--sequence-len 1024 --batch 1 --threads 1 --model-repl 1`. Expect p95 single-token-step < 12ms on warm path for this node class.

kevin: ran decode harness on node-07 (warm cache). results: p50 6.2ms, p95 11.8ms, p99 18.7ms. logs: error rate 0%.

tj: note: observed small kernel warnings in dmesg on node-08 before iperf: `NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00:00: Xid (PCIe) 31`, single occurrence. I raised a ticket but it didn't repeat after reboot. tagging @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: thanks — keep an eye. if Xid repeats under load, we'll demote the node from pool. for now proceed. Also confirm MTU across transit switches (spine) matches 9000. If not, we'll see fragmentation and throughput drops.

mirelle: next step: scale the NCCL all-reduce smoke across 4 nodes (2x per-rack). command used: `python -m tools.nccl_smoke --nodes 4 --backend nccl --message-size 16MB --iters 30`. target: aggregate bandwidth >= 80% of theoretical, and allreduce p95 within expected window.

infra-ci-bot: NCCL smoke completed: aggregate bw 10.8 GB/s (expected ~12 GB/s), all nodes OK, no timeouts. posting raw summary to artifact store: s3://redwood-artifacts/sea1/1845009999/nccl-smoke.log

kevin: observed small 5–7% variance between nodes in p95; probably scheduling skew. Recommend re-run with cpu isolation: `isolate-cpus=...` or set `taskset` affinity for the harness.

mirelle: agree. add this as action item for handoff doc: "if p95 variance > 10% across nodes, rerun with cpu pinning and capture perf top traces for 30s during run".

tj: ran a 1h soak with mixed decode + small NCCL: no new Xid, no GPU ECC errors, temp stable at 72C. power draw consistent.

mirelle: final checklist before handoff to capacity team:
- kernel >= 5.15 validated
- nvidia driver >= 535 validated
- cuda runtime 12.1 validated
- MTU 9000 and NIC offloads enabled across rack/spine validated
- nccl all-reduce smoke passed (10.8 GB/s)
- decode micro-bench p95 within target (11.8ms)
- one stray Xid seen once; monitor and retest if recurring

sre-oncall: I'll add a short monitoring alert: GPU Xid > 0 occurrences in 1h -> pager. Also add a dashboard panel for NCCL bw and decode p95.

mirelle: handoff: tagging capacity@ and eng-platform. Please take notes: sea1-gpu-pool-01 is green for initial onboarding but flagged node-08 for follow-up if Xid reappears.

kevin: leaving notes in the runbook (internal link). grabbing ownership for network-level followup. :white_check_mark:

tj: I'll schedule a second run tomorrow with CPU isolation and record perf.data.

mirelle: thanks team. closing this validation thread, creating a short L2 checklist for the next shift.

infra-ci-bot: thread archived to artifacts (run-id 1845009999).
